name: WashTec AG
summary: WashTec AG provides vehicle wash equipment in Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers gantry and conveyor tunnel carwashes, self-service and commercial vehicle wash equipment, water recycling systems, and other peripherals. It also provides servicing packages and digital smart service solutions, including maintenance arrangements for regular servicing, and digital systems for remote monitoring and equipment control, as well as sells spare parts. In addition, the company produces and sells chemical products for use in its wash equipment, such as shampoos, waxes, drying aids, and wheel cleaners.
